what: A 3×3 cell logo (nine rounded squares) turns on subtly cell by cell, each randomly delayed 0 to .35s, over 1s ease-in-out. From 1.2s on the duration shortens to .3s, so when another panel comes to the front (fx:off) the cells flicker off in a freshly drawn order, and when it returns (fx:on) they fill back in that same order. The order is redrawn on every turn-off, so the cell logo lights up differently each time

options.spread: Range of random delay per cell (sec), default .35
options.after: Length in seconds of the fade out and in after settling in place, default .3
options.settle: Time (s) to change from initial length to short length, default 1.2
options.delay: Initial pause before lighting up (s), default 0
options.back: Pause (seconds) when switched back on via fx:on, default 0 — if given, a new order delayed by that much is drawn (if absent, keeps the order drawn when it switched off)
options.[data-fx-part=cell]: Cell that lights up (SVG rect also works)
options.fx:off · fx:on: Fire at a panel to turn it off and on — hover-stage-swap fires at [data-fx] inside the background panel

use: <svg data-fx="cell-scatter-fade" viewBox="0 0 44 44"><rect data-fx-part="cell" x="0" y="0" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="currentColor"/>…</svg>
note: The original turns cells on with a CSS opacity transition and a per-cell --cell-delay (not GSAP), so it was ported as a CSS transition as is. The delay is random on every open, so per-cell delays differ between original and copy within the same range

from.where: index.html .bx-home__main .bx-mark — original #blockLogo (3×3, cell 12·gap 4·corner 2, delay random×.35s, turns on over 1200ms after the first 1s with 300ms, ease-in-out, brand hover turns it off with new delays then back on with the same delays — measured cell delays 184·333ms etc.)
